requests.prompt:
A clean 2D orthographic three-view layout sheet of ONE small cat room, drawn as a technical positioning reference on a plain warm white background. The sheet contains THREE panels arranged left to right, evenly spaced, all drawn in the same flat vector illustration style with gentle soft shading and absolutely no perspective distortion.

THE ROOM: a small rectangular cat room, 6.00 meters wide from left to right and 4.00 meters deep from front to back, with a wall 2.20 meters tall. The back wall has a wide window with white horizontal venetian blinds spanning the left-of-center of that wall, with a slim cream white window ledge just inside it holding two small potted green plants. The floor is light oak planks. The front wall of the room is removed, so the front edge is open.

FURNITURE, exactly nine pieces and no others - there is NO cardboard box and NO litter box anywhere in this room:
- a low tan wicker-style cat bed with a plump misty blue cushion, on the floor at the front-left
- a small cream round ceramic cat bowl right beside that cat bed, slightly further toward the front
- a coral orange patchwork yarn toy ball on the floor near the middle of the room, toward the front
- a tall misty blue cat climbing tower with a rope-wrapped post, two blue shelves and a small house-shaped bed with a round arched doorway at the top, standing in the back-left corner immediately to the LEFT of the window
- a slim cream white window ledge under the window holding two small potted green plants
- a misty blue writing desk against the back wall to the right of the window, with a black flat-screen monitor, a blue anglepoise desk lamp and a tiny potted plant on top
- a large misty blue rug scattered with white five-pointed stars lying flat on the floor in the middle-right area
- a long cream two-seat sofa with misty blue seat cushions and a small blue star pillow, standing against the right-hand wall running front to back
- a beige striped woven doormat lying flat along the open front edge of the floor, centered
A small cream colored cat with two dark eyes is curled up asleep on the sofa.

PANEL 1 - FRONT ELEVATION: the whole room seen perfectly straight on from the open front side, straight-on horizontal eye level, as if looking at a stage. The full 6.00 meter back wall fills the panel from edge to edge. The window with blinds is left of center, the cat climbing tower stands at the far left against the back wall, the desk is right of center, and the long sofa runs along the right-hand wall. The cat bed, the bowl and the toy ball sit on the floor in the foreground, the star rug lies flat center-right and the striped doormat lies along the very bottom edge. The cream cat is curled on the sofa. A thin dark-gray dimension line with small arrowheads under the panel marks the overall room width as 6.00 m, and a thin vertical dimension line at the left edge marks the wall height as 2.20 m.

PANEL 2 - TOP VIEW: the same room seen perfectly straight down from above as a floor plan, with the window wall along the TOP edge of the panel, the open front edge along the BOTTOM edge, the right-hand wall with the long sofa along the RIGHT edge and the left-hand wall along the LEFT edge. The window with its blinds and the cream ledge with the two plants run along the top edge, the cat tower is a circle in the top-left corner just to the left of the window, the desk is a rectangle against the top edge right of center, the long sofa is a long narrow rectangle running down along the right edge, the star rug is a large rectangle in the middle-right of the floor, the tan cat bed is a rectangle in the lower-left area, the small round bowl sits just to the right of the cat bed, the coral ball is a circle near the lower middle of the room, and the striped doormat is a long thin rectangle along the bottom edge. Thin dark-gray dimension lines with small arrowheads mark the room width as 6.00 m across the top and the room depth as 4.00 m down the left side.

PANEL 3 - SIDE ELEVATION: the same room seen perfectly straight on from the right-hand side wall, so the open front of the room is at the LEFT of the image and the window wall is at the RIGHT. The full 4.00 meter depth fills the panel. The striped doormat lies at the far left on the floor, the long sofa is seen from its end in the right foreground with the cream cat curled on it, the star rug lies flat on the floor in front of it, the coral ball sits on the floor, the tan cat bed with its blue cushion sits in the middle of the room, the tall misty blue cat tower stands near the right with the desk beside it against the window wall, and the window with blinds and the cream ledge with plants is at the far right. Draw every piece of furniture as a flat silhouette with a visible thin darker outline, and draw the pieces closest to the viewer as pale ghost outlines instead of solid fill, so nothing behind them is hidden. Thin dark-gray dimension lines with small arrowheads mark the room depth as 4.00 m along the bottom and the wall height as 2.20 m at the right.

STYLE: clean flat vector shapes with soft simple shading, warm cream walls, light oak plank floor, soft misty blue, cream, tan, coral orange and sage green furniture, absolutely no perspective, no isometric angle, perfectly straight orthographic lines, plain warm off-white background, only the small dimension labels as written text, no title, no captions, no other text, no watermark
